description: Create a new Talk conversation. One-on-one requires an invite user, group/public require a name. A preset creates a classified conversation (locked down: no public link, guests, SIP or recording, messages expire after 7 days), a channel (only moderators post, no calls, anyone can find and join it) or an announcement (a channel with a fixed audience, administrators only).

invite.description: User, group or team to invite, see source (required for one-on-one)

listable.description: Who can find and join the conversation: 'users' for regular users, 'everyone' also includes guest accounts (default 'none')

lobby.description: Keep non-moderators in the lobby until it is opened (default false)

messageExpiration.description: Seconds after which messages disappear, 0 to keep them (default 0)

preset.description: Conversation preset (Talk 25). Other parameters override its settings

readOnly.description: Only moderators can post or call (default false)

roomName.description: Name for the conversation (required for group and public)

source.description: What invite is: 'users', 'groups' or 'circles' (a Team). Default 'groups', except one-on-one, which is always a user

name: talk_create_conversation
title: Create Talk Conversation
